privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect, what we do with it and what your rights are. The data controller is YUZU LABS SAS, the company behind Digitip, SIREN 994 879 013, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau, France.
privacy.s1Body: Account data (name, email), business data (company name, VAT, shipping/billing address), tipping data (amount, date, recipient staff member), payout data handled by Stripe (bank account, identity verification), and technical data (IP address, browser, language) used for security and analytics.
privacy.s2Body: To operate the service (process tips, manage staff, issue invoices), to comply with legal obligations (accounting, tax, anti-money laundering), to improve the product, and to contact you about your account. We never sell your data.
privacy.s3Body: Card data is collected and processed exclusively by Stripe. Digitip servers never see or store card numbers. Stripe acts as an independent data controller for payment and KYC data. See stripe.com/privacy for details.
privacy.s4Body: We share data only with: Stripe (payments), Supabase (authentication & database hosting, EU region), Resend/our email provider (transactional emails), Meta to measure our ads only if you accepted it (see section 7), and authorities when legally required.
privacy.s5Body: Account data is kept as long as your account is active, plus 3 years for commercial records. Accounting records (invoices, tips) are kept 10 years as required by law. You can request deletion at any time.
privacy.s6Body: You can access, correct, delete or export your data, object to processing, and lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (CNIL in France). Email privacy@digitip.app to exercise your rights.
privacy.s7Body: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication and session management, which do not require your consent. On our presentation and ordering pages we also keep, for 30 days, the name of the advertising campaign that brought you (utm_ parameters), with no identifier, to know which campaigns lead to orders; it serves no other purpose and is not combined with any third-party data. Only with your consent, given or refused in the banner shown on those pages, we use the pixel of Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. (_fbp and _fbc cookies) to measure visits and purchases coming from our ads on Facebook and Instagram. If you accepted it and place an order, we also send Meta, through its Conversions API, the order amount, your email address in hashed form (SHA-256), your country, your IP address and your browser, to link the purchase to the ad. Meta and Digitip are joint controllers for this collection; Meta then processes the data under its own policy (facebook.com/privacy/policy). Your choice is kept for 6 months and can be changed at any time below. Refusing has no effect on your use of the site.
privacy.s8Body: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. Access is restricted to authorised staff. We conduct regular security reviews.
privacy.s9Body: For any question about this policy, or to exercise your rights, email privacy@digitip.app or write to YUZU LABS SAS, Data Protection, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau, France.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Digitip. By creating an account or placing an order, you accept them in full.
terms.s1Body: Digitip provides NFC SmartTags and software that lets customers leave contactless tips. Tips are collected by Digitip through Stripe, then paid out to the receiving business on the bank account it has connected, once its identity is verified. The business then passes those amounts on to its staff through its own arrangements, typically payroll. Digitip acts as a technical facilitator and is not any staff member's employer.
terms.s2Body: You must be at least 18, have the authority to bind your business, and operate a lawful hospitality or service activity in a country where Stripe Connect is available.
terms.s3Body: SmartTag packs are sold as a one-time hardware purchase: once the plaque is paid for, no recurring amount is due to use it. Tipping works without a subscription. The Digitip platform earns revenue through a service fee added on top of the tip and paid by the person leaving it (see section 5): nothing is taken out of the tip itself, the recipient receives the full amount chosen, and with no tips nothing is owed. Digitip also offers an optional subscription, Digitip Pro, which unlocks the additional features described in the dashboard. It is taken out voluntarily, can be cancelled at any time, and is required neither to receive tips nor to use the plaque. Hardware is non-refundable once shipped, without prejudice to the legal warranties and the right of withdrawal set out in the terms of sale.
terms.s4Body: All payments are processed by Stripe. VAT is applied automatically according to your country. Hardware is paid for once, at the time of the order; no recurring charge is made. A 30-day grace period applies to SmartTags before full deactivation if the account is closed.
terms.s5Body: Digitip acts as a technical payment facilitator. Each tip is attributed to the staff member chosen by the customer, and that attribution is the basis for the statement the business uses for payroll. Funds are collected by Digitip through Stripe, then paid out to the business on the bank account it has connected. Until the business completes the identity verification required by anti-money-laundering rules, its tip pages are not open to the public and no tip can be collected on its behalf. Digitip takes nothing out of the tip: its revenue comes from the service fee added on top of the chosen amount and paid by the customer, who is shown the exact figure before confirming payment. That fee covers bank processing costs and running the service. Digitip only holds funds for as long as needed to pay them out.
terms.s6Body: You must provide accurate information, keep credentials safe, use the service lawfully, inform your staff and customers appropriately, and comply with applicable tax and employment laws regarding tips.
terms.s7Body: You may not use Digitip for fraudulent transactions, money laundering, prohibited activities under Stripe's terms, or to process payments unrelated to tipping.
terms.s8Body: Digitip is provided as-is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amounts paid by you to Digitip in the 12 months preceding the claim. We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or data loss beyond our control.
terms.s9Body: You may close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these terms or create risk for us, payment partners or other users. On termination, SmartTags are deactivated after 30 days.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by French law. Disputes between businesses are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts within the remit of the Colmar Court of Appeal, unless mandatory consumer law provides otherwise.
terms.s11Body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be notified by email at least 30 days before they apply.
terms.s12Body: To receive tips, the business must confirm its identity and provide an IBAN through Stripe's secure flow. This step, required by EU regulation (KYC / AML), is kept to the strict minimum. Until it is complete, the business's tip pages stay closed, so no tip can be left or collected on its behalf.
terms.s13Body: In rare cases a collected tip may remain unpaid: if the business's account is restricted between the charge and the transfer, or if the transfer fails repeatedly. After 90 days, those amounts are automatically refunded to the customer who made the payment. Only the tip is refunded, not the service fee, which covered the bank processing of a payment that did go through. Digitip holds no unpaid funds beyond that period.
terms.s14Body: Digitip is not the recipients' employer and is not involved in the employment relationship or payroll. Tips paid directly to employees may qualify for an exemption from social contributions and income tax under applicable rules, subject to conditions. It is the establishment's and/or the recipient's responsibility to meet their reporting obligations (in particular in payroll). To help, Digitip provides the administrator with a monthly statement of amounts paid to each recipient. Digitip does not provide legal or tax advice.

cgv.title: Terms of Sale
cgv.intro: These Terms of Sale (ToS) govern all orders for products and services placed on digitip.app. By confirming an order, the buyer unconditionally accepts these Terms. Seller: YUZU LABS SAS, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau, SIREN 994 879 013, contact@digitip.app.
cgv.s1Body: YUZU LABS SAS sells under the Digitip brand: (1) pre-programmed NFC epoxy plaques ("SmartTags") enabling customers to leave contactless tips, and (2) access to the Digitip software platform (dashboard, staff management, analytics). Essential product characteristics are detailed on the order pages. The Digitip Pro subscription, monthly or yearly, is paid in advance and renews automatically at each term. It can be cancelled at any time from the Billing page: cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid, with no pro-rata refund, and the account then returns to the free plan. Any free trial is shown before subscribing; unless cancelled before it ends, the subscription starts when it ends.
cgv.s2Body: Prices are shown in euros excluding VAT. Applicable VAT is calculated by Stripe at checkout based on your country of tax residence. YUZU LABS SAS reserves the right to change prices at any time; orders are invoiced at the price shown at the time of confirmation. Delivery is free across Europe.
cgv.s3Body: Any order placed on digitip.app constitutes acceptance of these Terms, the prices, and the product descriptions. YUZU LABS SAS reserves the right to refuse or cancel any order in cases of suspected fraud, unresolved prior dispute, or product unavailability. A confirmation email is sent within 24 hours of validation.
cgv.s4Body: Payment is made in full online at the time of order via Stripe (debit/credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Payment data is collected and processed exclusively by Stripe: YUZU LABS SAS servers never see or store any banking data. In the event of payment failure, the order is automatically cancelled. For business buyers, any amount unpaid when due automatically bears late-payment interest at three times the French statutory interest rate and a fixed recovery fee of €40 (article L441-10 of the French Commercial Code). No discount is granted for early payment.
cgv.s5Body: SmartTags ship from France within 3 business days of payment confirmation. Shipping is free to the EU countries offered at checkout and to Switzerland. For Switzerland the sale is an export invoiced without French VAT; Swiss import VAT and any customs duties are paid by the buyer. A tracking email is sent on dispatch. YUZU LABS SAS is not liable for delays caused by the carrier, force majeure, or incorrect delivery details provided by the buyer.
cgv.s6Body: In accordance with Article L221-18 of the French Consumer Code, any consumer (non-professional buyer) has 14 calendar days from receipt of the parcel to exercise their right of withdrawal, without reason or penalty. Products must be returned unused, in their original packaging, at the buyer's expense. Refund will be made within 14 days of receipt and verification of the return. This right does not apply to orders placed for professional purposes (B2B), or to products that have been used or damaged after delivery. Commercial "Satisfied or refunded" guarantee: in addition to the right of withdrawal, and including orders placed for business purposes, any buyer can get their SmartTag order refunded within 14 calendar days of receiving the parcel, with no reason required, by writing to contact@digitip.app and returning the SmartTags complete and in good condition. The price paid is refunded within 14 days of receiving the return. Return shipping is paid by the buyer. This guarantee does not cover the Digitip Pro subscription.
cgv.s7Body: SmartTags benefit from the statutory warranty of conformity (Articles L217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, 2 years from delivery for non-professional buyers) and the warranty against hidden defects (Articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code). In addition, YUZU LABS SAS offers a lifetime commercial warranty: any SmartTag showing a manufacturing defect or failure under normal use will be replaced free of charge upon sending a photo to contact@digitip.app.
cgv.s8Body: For any after-sales request, contact contact@digitip.app with your order number. YUZU LABS SAS will respond within 48 business hours and process any guaranteed replacement within 5 business days of confirmation.
cgv.s9Body: Using the Digitip platform to collect tips does not result in any deduction from the tips collected: the recipient receives the full amount chosen by the customer. The service fee (a fixed part of €0.25 per transaction and a variable part of 5% of the tip) is added on top of the tip and paid by the person leaving it, who is shown the exact figure before confirming payment. That fee covers payment processing (Stripe), infrastructure hosting, fraud prevention and service maintenance. No fee is due if no tips are collected.
cgv.s10Body: YUZU LABS SAS cannot be held liable for indirect damages (lost profits, loss of customers, data loss) related to the use or inability to use SmartTags or the platform. The liability of YUZU LABS SAS is limited to amounts actually paid by the buyer in the 12 months preceding the loss.

Disputes between professionals fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Colmar Court of Appeal, unless mandatory law provides otherwise. These Terms are governed by French law.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does it work with every phone?
faq.a1: Nearly every recent phone reads NFC. For the others, each plaque also has a QR code you scan with the camera.
faq.q2: Can customers pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay?
faq.a2: Yes, and with any bank card. They don't download any app.
faq.q3: How long does a plaque last?
faq.a3: A very long time. There's no battery and nothing that wears out: the chip powers up when a phone comes close. And if it breaks, we replace it, for life.
faq.q4: Can I use Digitip in several venues?
faq.a4: Yes. One account can run as many venues and teams as you like, each with its own plaques and stats.
faq.q5: My plaque is damaged or stopped working. What now?
faq.a5: Email us a photo and we'll ship you a new one for free. The lifetime guarantee comes with every pack.
faq.q6: Do I need a company number or a special status?
faq.a6: Not to order plaques. To receive tips, the business goes through a one-time check in Digitip (the manager's identity and bank details), because anti-money-laundering law requires it. Your staff don't create any account: each tip is recorded in their name and you pay it with their wages.
faq.a7: From the service fee, paid by the person leaving the tip, never from the tip itself. For a €10 tip the customer pays €10.75: €0.25 fixed plus 5% of the tip. You get the €10. Of the 75 cents, about €0.41 goes to Stripe (€0.25 fixed + 1.5% of the amount paid) and €0.34 to Digitip, to run and improve the service. You have nothing to pay each month.

doubleGuarantee.g1body: It's made for everyday use: thick resin, rounded corners, NFC chip set inside.
doubleGuarantee.g2body: If a plaque breaks or stops working, we send you a new one for free, with no time limit.
doubleGuarantee.g3body: No shipping cost to France, the EU and Switzerland, whatever the pack.
doubleGuarantee.g4body: You pay for the plaque once, and receive tips for as long as you like.

staff.subtitle: Invite your team and see who's ready.

new.title: Invite someone
new.subtitle: They get an email with a link to join the team.
new.fullNameHint: This is what customers see on the tip page. A first name is enough, like “Alice”.
new.errorGeneric: The invitation didn't send. Try again.

detail.editNameHint: This is what customers see on the tip page.
detail.deactivateConfirm: Remove this person from the team? They won't show on the tip page any more, but their history stays in your statements.

establishments.title: Establishments
establishments.subtitle: Your venues and their tip links.
establishments.empty: No venue yet. Create one to start receiving tips.
establishments.name: Establishment name
establishments.deleteConfirm: This venue will be deleted for good. Carry on?
establishments.createHint: Only create another venue if you run several. It'll then need a plaque, linked from the Plaques tab: without one it can't receive tips.

stickers.title: Plaques
stickers.subtitle: The plaques linked to your venues. When they scan, customers choose who gets the tip.
stickers.infoBanner: Digitip prepares and ships the plaques. To order more, go to Billing. To replace one, write to contact@digitip.app.

analytics.title: Stats
analytics.subtitle: Your tips and who's getting the most, over the last 30 days.
analytics.noData: There aren't enough tips yet to show anything.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your team name, your logo and the amounts offered to customers.
settings.logoHelp: PNG, JPG or WebP, ideally square, 2 MB max.
settings.tipsHelp: They show on the tip page, smallest first. You can have three or four: leave the last box empty to offer only three.
settings.noGroup: Your account isn't linked to any venue yet.
settings.accountantEmailHelp: On the 5th of each month we send them last month's tip statement, and you too.

overview.title: SaaS overview
overview.subtitle: Platform-wide metrics across every group and establishment.
overview.purposeCallout: Use this area to run Digitip: NFC stock, hardware orders, roles, Stripe health, and data integrity. All figures come straight from Supabase.
overview.topEmpty: No successful transactions in the last 30 days.

smarttags.title: SmartTags
smarttags.subtitle: Generate batches, export for the factory, assign to establishments.
smarttags.searchActive: Search by short id, establishment or group…
smarttags.stockEmpty: No tags in stock. Generate a batch to get started.
smarttags.rangeHelp: Both short IDs must belong to the same batch. All in-stock tags between them (inclusive, factory order) will be assigned.

orders.title: SmartTag orders
orders.subtitle: Track payment, fulfillment and shipping.
orders.nothingToDo: Nothing to do on this order right now.
orders.linkedEmpty: No tags linked to this order yet.
orders.acquisitionHint: Paid orders by originating campaign (utm_ parameters of the last tagged visit, within 30 days). "Direct": no tagged visit before the purchase.
orders.acquisitionEmpty: No paid order in the last 30 days.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: {n} transactions · {volume} successful volume
transactions.subtitleFiltered: {shown} rows shown (max 500) · {total} transactions matching filters · {volume} successful volume (succeeded)
transactions.rpcFallback: Exact totals require SQL migration 00019 (admin_transactions_summary). Showing an approximation from the current page.
transactions.truncatedList: More than {limit} transactions match these filters, narrow the date range or group.

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Auth accounts and user_roles assignments (live Supabase data).

webhooks.title: Stripe webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Raw log of received events (processing, errors).
webhooks.rlsHint: Apply migration 00019 to allow super_admin reads on webhook_events.

stripe.title: Stripe (project data)
stripe.subtitle: Deep links to the Stripe dashboard from IDs stored in the database.

search.title: Global search
search.subtitle: Quick search across groups, establishments, staff, tags and transactions.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Sensitive actions performed from the platform admin.

statements.title: Monthly statements
statements.subtitle: What each person got in tips, month by month. This is what you give your accountant.
statements.autoBodyAccountant: On the 5th of each month, we email last month's statement to you and to {email}.
statements.autoBodyNoAccountant: On the 5th of each month, we email you last month's statement. Your accountant can get it too.

payments.title: Payment account
payments.subtitle: Your venue's tips arrive here, then go to your bank account.
payments.statusReady: Your venue is verified and can receive tips.
payments.statusPending: Stripe is checking your details. Your tip page will open by itself as soon as it's done.
payments.loadFailed: Your payment account won't load. Reload the page, or try again in a moment.
payments.noEstablishment: Your account isn't linked to any venue yet.
payments.statusNotStarted: Your venue isn't verified yet, so customers can't leave a tip. The form below takes about 2 minutes.
payments.statusIncomplete: You started the check but didn't finish it. Pick the form below up where you left off.
payments.verifyIntro: This form is Stripe's, who handle the payments. The law requires checking who receives the money before the first payment. Your bank details go straight to Stripe and never through Digitip.
payments.verifyLoadFailed: The verification form won't load. Reload the page, or try again in a moment.
payments.verifyExited: Finished the form? The page updates by itself as soon as Stripe confirms it.

pro.activeBody: After every tip, customers can leave a Google review and a short note for the team. You can change plan or cancel whenever you like.
pro.unavailable: Pro isn't open yet. Try again later.
pro.failed: The payment page won't open. Try again in a moment.
pro.reviewTeaserTitle: {count, plural, one {# customer tipped you this month} other {# customers tipped you this month}}
pro.reviewTeaserBody: With Digitip Pro, they would have been asked to leave a Google review right after.
pro.monthsFree: {months, plural, one {# month free} other {# months free}}
pro.checkoutDoneBody: Your subscription switches on in a few seconds. If Pro doesn't show yet, reload the page.
pro.trialDaysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
pro.trialBody: When the trial ends, the subscription is {price} a month excl. VAT. Stop it before then and you pay nothing.
pro.trialBodyNoPrice: When the trial ends, the subscription starts by itself. Stop it before then and you pay nothing.
pro.canceledBody: Digitip Pro works until {date}, then stops, and you won't pay anything more. You can switch it back on until then.
pro.reviewTeaserBodyNoLink: With Digitip Pro, they could have left a note for the team, and a Google review once your listing is linked.
pro.keepNote: We'll ask for a card, but the first payment only happens on {date}. Cancel any time.
pro.freeTrialBody: Pro is on until {date}. You haven't given a card, so if you do nothing it simply stops and you pay nothing.
pro.offerLead: After the tip, we ask the customer to leave a Google review and a short note for whoever served them.
pro.offerLeadCount: {count, plural, one {# customer tipped you this month.} other {# customers tipped you this month.}} With Pro, they would have been asked to leave a Google review.
pro.benefitReviewsBody: A button right after payment that opens your Google listing directly.
pro.benefitComplimentsBody: The customer ticks what they liked and can write a line. The server finds it in their own space.
pro.benefitListingBody: Every week we check your Google rating and review count.
pro.reassuranceTrial: No card needed. After 30 days Pro simply stops if you do nothing.
pro.previewLabel: What the customer sees after paying
pro.previewReviewBody: Leave a Google review, it takes 10 seconds.
pro.alwaysFree: Tips, your team, analytics, statements and delivery to your accountant stay free, with or without Pro.

verifyBanner.titleBlocked: Your plaque can't take payments yet
verifyBanner.bodyNotStarted: There's still the Stripe check to do, about 2 minutes, just once. Without it, customers can't leave a tip.
verifyBanner.bodyIncomplete: You started the Stripe check without finishing it. Only a few fields are left.
verifyBanner.bodyVerifying: Stripe is finishing the check. You don't need to do anything, your tips will be paid as soon as it's done.

verify.label: Verify your business
verify.body: About 2 minutes, just once. Until it's done, your tip page stays closed.

team.label: Add your team
team.body: Everyone you add gets an invitation, and their tips are recorded in their name.

review.label: Link your Google listing
review.body: You only do this once. With Digitip Pro, customers see a button to leave a review right after tipping.

firstTip.label: Take a first tip
firstTip.body: Open your tip page to see exactly what customers see. It's the easiest way to check everything works.

proImpact.label: Digitip Pro
proImpact.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
proImpact.noLinkBody: Your Google listing isn't linked yet, so customers don't see the button to leave a review.
proImpact.reviewsPending: We're reading your Google listing this week; the review counter starts after that.
proImpact.clicksBody: customers opened your Google listing after tipping
proImpact.clicksEmpty: no tips in this period yet

compliments.title: Customer notes
compliments.subtitle: What your customers wrote to the team after tipping.
compliments.lockedTitle: Notes are part of Digitip Pro
compliments.lockedBody: After tipping, customers can say what they liked and write a line to whoever served them. It shows up here, and everyone sees their own.
compliments.sample1: Julie recommended the perfect wine, thank you!
compliments.sample2: Quick, and always with a smile.
compliments.emptyBody: They'll show up here as soon as a customer leaves one. Nothing to set up: the form appears on its own after the tip.
compliments.staffTitle: {count, plural, one {# note from your customers} other {# notes from your customers}}

welcome.title: Join {name}
welcome.subtitle: Card tips, no cash needed.
welcome.bullet1: Customers tip you with their phone. No cash, no app.
welcome.bullet2: You see your tips come in as they happen, and your workplace pays them with your wages.

identity.title: Who are you?
identity.subtitle: Pick your first name to join the team.
identity.notListed: My name isn't in the list →

namePhoto.title: Your first name and a photo
namePhoto.subtitle: This is what customers see when they pay.
namePhoto.photoTip: With a photo, customers find the right person more easily.
namePhoto.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · 2 MB max

payment.title: Receive your tips
payment.subtitle: Last step: link your bank account with Stripe.
payment.bullet1: Once your account is created, Stripe walks you through setting up your payouts. It takes a few clicks.
payment.bullet2: Stripe receives your ID and IBAN. Digitip never sees them.
payment.bullet3: Your employer can't see your IBAN.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We'll send you a 6-digit code. That's also how you'll sign in from now on.
verify.prefilled: Your manager already filled in your email. You can change it if it's wrong.

acceptInvite.title: You're almost there
acceptInvite.body: Click the button to activate your invitation and set up your tips.

onboarding.fillField: Fill in this field to continue.

done.title: Your space is ready
done.body: {name} is set up. You can run your team and follow your tips.
done.payoutsPendingTitle: One more step to receive tips
done.payoutsPendingBody: Your venue still has to be checked by Stripe: about 2 minutes, just once. Until then, your tip page stays closed. The button is at the top of your dashboard.

address.manualHint: No suggestions? Type your address yourself.

googleReview.title: Your business
googleReview.subtitle: Search for your Google listing. We pick up your name, address and review link from it in one go.
googleReview.skip: My business is not on Google
googleReview.noResults: We can't find anything. Try another name, or add the link yourself.
googleReview.manualIntro: Paste the “Ask for reviews” link from your Google listing.
googleReview.manualHelp: Can't get into the listing? Find your venue on Google Maps, open it and copy the page address. A place ID works too.
googleReview.manualInvalid: That isn't a Google review link.
googleReview.fieldHint: With Digitip Pro, customers see a button to leave a Google review right after tipping. Pro is free for 30 days from your first tip, and your link is already saved.
googleReview.searchUnavailable: Google search isn't responding right now. No problem, just paste your link below.
googleReview.guide1: Open your listing in Google Maps or Google Business Profile, signed in with the business account.
googleReview.guide2: Tap “Ask for reviews”. Google shows a short link that looks like g.page/r/…/review.
googleReview.guide3: Copy that link and paste it below.
googleReview.gateTitle: The review button isn't on yet
googleReview.gateBody: Your link is saved, but without Digitip Pro customers don't see it after tipping.

confirm.title: Is this right?
confirm.subtitle: We took what Google knows about your venue. Fix anything that's wrong.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We'll send you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.

activate.title: Your plaque is waiting for you
activate.body: To protect your tips, we send the setup link to the address used for the order: {email}.
activate.sentBody: Open the email sent to {email} and click “Activate my plaque”. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam.
activate.why: Not the manager? This plaque isn't in use yet, come back a little later.
activate.error: That didn't send. Try again in a moment, or write to contact@digitip.app.
activate.limited: You've asked a lot of times. Try again in an hour, or write to contact@digitip.app.
activate.noEmail: This plaque isn't activated yet. Write to contact@digitip.app with a photo of the plaque and we'll activate it with you.

consent.text: We use a Meta cookie to see whether our ads work. It's only set if you accept it.
